cases.mechanism_detail: In a genetically unsolved VHL case, a ~4-kb insertion containing a ~3-kb SVA was found in VHL intron 1 (described also as the promoter region) at a site with ENCODE regulatory elements; authors suggest it may affect VHL transcription, but RNA was unavailable to test.
cases.quote: Nanopore long-read sequencing analysis validated this ME insertion, which was ⁓4 kb and included 3 kb SVA transposon (Supplementary Material, Fig. S3).
